name: Cash Standing Order
definition: Instruction given by a party that has explicit authority to instruct a debit on the account, ie, either the debit account owner or originating party, to a first agent, to process cash transfers at specified intervals during an implicit or explicit period of time. A standing order is given once and is valid for an open or closed period of time.

ZeroSweepIndicator.name: Zero Sweep Indicator
ZeroSweepIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the liquidity transfer standing order is defined as a zero sweeping order. When true, the liquidity transfer standing order will transfer all amount of money out of the account so the resulting balance is  zero.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies if the account is debited or credited by the standing order.

FloorAmount.name: Floor Amount
FloorAmount.definition: Minimum amount of money that should remain on the debtor's account, for cash management purposes.

RelatedCashServices.name: Related Cash Services
RelatedCashServices.definition: Cash management services which provide standing order facilities.

CreditTransfer.name: Credit Transfer
CreditTransfer.definition: Standing order causes a payment instruction at regular intervals, eg, as specified by its frequency.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Cash account for which a standing order applies.
